main.description: A blob of an account's hidden profile (avatar, banner or link icon), for a viewer who may see the profile. Served and authenticated as tools.umbrae.actor.getProfile. The app serves a blob only if the profile refers to it; the viewer checks the bytes against the CID.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The profile doesn't refer to this blob, or the app can't fetch it.
